title: [Medium][NATIVE-004] Web state-driven URL loading does not clear existing iframe srcdoc
source: Prior bounded read-only open-issues GET archived in ../open-issues.json
original_required_criteria: Data→Url→Data transitions via direct state assignment and remembered-state updates.
Navigator and state loaders produce the same iframe attributes and page.
Cross-origin destination with CSP/X-Frame-Options failure does not leave old content falsely reported as new.
